verdicts_or_reports.field: document text after Unordered list action
verdicts_or_reports.expected: With all lines of Indent.md ('- item' then '  - child') selected, the Unordered list action should detect the existing list markers on every selected line and toggle them off, leaving 'item' and '  child' (no duplicated marker).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Tapping Unordered list with all text selected produced 'item\n  - - child\n- ': the non-indented '- item' marker was removed, but the indented '  - child' line was not detected as an existing list item and got a second marker ('  - - child').
steps: Long-press the text and choose Select all
Tap the Unordered list action button in the bottom formatting toolbar

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Editor (Notes.md) with Settings > Edit Mode > Unordered list character set to Plus (+)
verdicts_or_reports.expected: With "Unordered list character" set to "Plus (+)" (verified checked in the setting dialog), tapping Unordered list on an empty line should insert "+ ".
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Tapping Unordered list always inserts a dash: the editor line became "- " even though the configured unordered list character is "+". Earlier, with "Asterisk (*)" selected, the action also inserted "- ", so the preference is not used by the action at all.
steps: Go to More > Settings > Edit Mode > scroll to Unordered list character
Open Notes.md from Files and place the cursor on the empty last line
Tap the Unordered list action in the bottom formatting toolbar
Observe that '- ' is inserted instead of '+ '

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Settings > Edit Mode > Unordered list character dialog
verdicts_or_reports.expected: The dialog opened from the "Unordered list character" setting should be titled "Unordered list character" (matching the setting being edited).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: The unordered-list-character chooser dialog is titled "Theme", which is the title of the unrelated Appearance > Theme setting. The options inside are Dash (-), Asterisk (*) and Plus (+), confirming it is the list-character dialog.
steps: Go to More > Settings > Edit Mode
Scroll down to Miscellaneous and tap 'Unordered list character'

verdicts_or_reports.screen: File browser > Create a new file or folder dialog
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Choosing the 'todo.txt' type should set the extension to '.txt' (the supported todo.txt format's file extension, as used by the existing todo.txt file), so the new file has a single '.txt' extension.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Choosing Type 'todo.txt' sets the extension field to '.todo.txt', duplicating the format name into the extension. Other types produce single extensions (.md, .txt, .adoc, .org, .csv).
steps: Open Files and tap the + new file FAB
Open the Type spinner and choose 'todo.txt'
Observe the extension field next to the Name field
